descriptions.notStarted: Let's go check with #b#p1102002##k, the Mount Instructor, to see whether your Mount will recover its health if it goes into the special Incubator.
descriptions.inProgress: #p1102002# says he's done everything he could but the Mount keeps getting weaker and weaker. As a last resort, he suggests you seek help from #b#p1101001##k. He then hints that you may gain something more valuable if you #bsincerely devote time and energy to your Mount#k.
descriptions.completed: The Mount which #p1101001# had revived was not the same #t1902006#.
